```{r Plot Setup}
# Colors
new_colors_face <- c("#FF0000","#8B0000")
new_colors_body <- c("#E4CD04","#BA8E23")
new_colors_place <- c("#008000","#013220")
new_colors_words <- c("#0000FF","#000066")

# Fill
new_fill_face <- c("#FF0000","#FF0000","#FF0000","#FF0000")
new_fill_body <- c("#E4CD04","#E4CD04","#E4CD04","#E4CD04")
new_fill_place <- c("#008000","#008000","#008000")
new_fill_words <- c("#0000FF","#0000FF")

# Bars
dodge <- position_dodge2(width = 1, preserve = "single", padding = 0)
roi_order_byFace <- c("IOG_faces", "pFus_faces", "mFus_faces","pSTS_faces")
roi_order_byBodies <- c("OTS_bodies", "LOS_limbs", "ITG_limbs","MTG_limbs")
roi_order_byPlace <- c("CoS_places", "MOG_places", "IPS_places")
roi_order_byWord <- c("pOTS_words", "mOTS_words")

```

```{r}
# keep only lh/rh & two groups
df_posthoc <- df.ROIsize_cat_latdors %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
         group %in% c("adolescents","Adults"))

# helper: Welch t-test p-value or NA if a cell is incomplete
ttest_p <- function(x, y) {
  if (length(unique(x)) > 1 && length(unique(y)) > 1) {
    # x = totalvox, y = group
    tryCatch(t.test(x ~ y, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  } else NA_real_
}

p_to_stars <- function(p) case_when(
  is.na(p)       ~ "",
  p < 0.001      ~ "***",
  p < 0.01       ~ "**",
  p < 0.05       ~ "*",
  TRUE           ~ ""
)

hemi_x <- function(h) ifelse(h == "lh", 1.5, 3.5)

# compute raw p-values per ROI × hemi × category
sig_tbl_raw <- df_posthoc %>%
  group_by(category, ROI, hemi) %>%
  summarise(p = ttest_p(totalvox, group), .groups = "drop")

# optional: adjust within each category family (BH)
sig_tbl <- sig_tbl_raw %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    stars = p_to_stars(p),     # use adjusted p for stars; swap to 'p' to use unadjusted
    x     = hemi_x(hemi),
    y     = 2500                    # fits your current y-limits (-3, 9)
  ) %>%
  filter(stars != "")

```


```{r 5A - Category Selectivity, fig.width=12, fig.height=4, warning=F, message=F, echo=FALSE}
#png(file.path(output_directory, "F5A_ROISize_bar_faces.png"), units="in", width=4, height=2.25, res=300)


t_faces <- df.ROIsize_cat_latdors %>%
  filter(category == "face") %>%
  mutate(
         ROI = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_byFace),
         hemi = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh", "rh", "mh", "zh")),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("adolescents", "Adults"))) %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh", "rh")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = interaction(group, hemi, sep = "."), 
                y = totalvox, 
                fill = group, 
                alpha = stream)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", width = 0.8, fun = "mean", size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE,  color = "#8B0000") +
  labs(y = "ROI Size (# Voxels)") +
  facet_grid(~ ROI) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=16),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray96",size = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        text = element_text(family = "Avenir"),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "white")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = new_colors_face, na.translate = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("lateraldorsal" = 0.45, "ventral" = .85)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = new_colors_face, na.translate = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 2500, 500), limits = c(0, 2700)) +
  theme(axis.line=element_blank(),axis.text.x=element_blank(),
          axis.text.y=element_blank(),axis.ticks=element_blank(),
          axis.title.x=element_blank(),
          axis.title.y=element_blank(),legend.position="none")

t_faces
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
png(file.path(output_directory, "F5.ROISize_bar_ALL.png"), units="in", width=12, height=3.5, res=300)

# Faces
sig_faces <- sig_tbl %>%
  filter(category == "face") %>%
  mutate(
    ROI  = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_byFace),
    hemi = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh","rh"))
  )
t_faces <- t_faces + geom_text(data = sig_faces,
                               aes(x = x, y = y, label = stars),
                               inherit.aes = FALSE,
                               family = "Avenir", fontface = "bold", size = 5)

# Bodies
sig_bodies <- sig_tbl %>%
  filter(category == "Bodies") %>%
  mutate(
    ROI  = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_byBodies),
    hemi = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh","rh"))
  )
t_bodies <- t_bodies + geom_text(data = sig_bodies,
                                 aes(x = x, y = y, label = stars),
                                 inherit.aes = FALSE,
                                 family = "Avenir", fontface = "bold", size = 5)

# Places
sig_places <- sig_tbl %>%
  filter(category == "places") %>%
  mutate(
    ROI  = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_byPlace),
    hemi = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh","rh"))
  )
t_place <- t_place + geom_text(data = sig_places,
                               aes(x = x, y = y, label = stars),
                               inherit.aes = FALSE,
                               family = "Avenir", fontface = "bold", size = 5)

# Words
sig_words <- sig_tbl %>%
  filter(category == "words") %>%
  mutate(
    ROI  = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_byWord),
    hemi = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh","rh"))
  )
t_words <- t_words + geom_text(data = sig_words,
                               aes(x = x, y = y, label = stars),
                               inherit.aes = FALSE,
                               family = "Avenir", fontface = "bold", size = 5)


p <- (t_words | t_bodies | t_faces | t_place) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2, 4, 4, 3), guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.25, "lines")
  )
p
```
